hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE "[a-zA-Z0-9_./-]+\.py" | head -1); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -q "backend/"; then grep -nE "\b(price|amount|cost|total)\b.*:\s*float\b" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && echo "WARNING: possible float used for a money field in $FILE — per .ai/engineering.md this must be integer cents or Decimal" || true; fi'
